deadline.value: January 12 application deadline for Fall admission.
deadline.quote: We are currently accepting applications for Fall 2027 PhD admission with an application deadline of January 12, 2027.

gre_subject.value: GRE subject scores optional; ideally received before January 15.
gre_subject.quote: Ideally, applicants should take the GRE test(s) in time for the official results to arrive before the January 15 deadline.

supervisor.value: List any research areas of interest and faculty members of interest.
supervisor.quote: List any research areas of interest to you as well as faculty members you would be interested in working with. This section is not required for MS applicants.

funding.value: PhD applicants applying by deadline are automatically considered for fellowships and awards.
funding.quote: Students who apply to our PhD program by the deadline are automatically considered for a number of fellowships and/or awards that support graduate student success.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's degree or expected attainment by end of summer required for admission.
entry_route.quote: To be considered for admission, you must have a bachelor’s degree or expect to attain one by the end of summer 2027.
